notes.categories: Mental abilities can be equipped by ANY player/archetype (archetypes="ALL"). Physical abilities are gated to specific position archetypes.
notes.tier_numbers: Under each archetype requirement, bronze/silver/gold/platinum are the MINIMUM rating in that attribute needed to unlock that tier. 'min_to_unlock' = the bronze value (floor to get the ability at all). Example: Jammer needs >=82 Press for Bronze.
notes.dual_attribute: Some abilities have a 'primary' and a 'secondary' requirement (e.g. Off Platform = Throw Power + Short Throw Accuracy). You must meet ALL listed requirements for that tier.
notes.positions: POS and archetype are taken verbatim from the source workbook. Note archetype names can repeat across positions with different abilities (e.g. Gritty Possession on WR vs TE; Power Rush on EDGE vs DT).
notes.sidekick: Sidekick (a back/FB pass-block ability) has no row in this source, which contains no FB position, so its archetypes=[]. (The earlier rough table placed it under a 'North/South Blocker' FB archetype.)
notes.xp_cost: The source workbook also lists an XP/skill-point cost per tier; it is omitted here. Ask if you want it added.
